remaining_one: {{count}} conflicted file left. Resolve it to continue.
remaining_other: {{count}} conflicted files left. Resolve them to continue.
ready: All conflicts are resolved. You can continue.

empty.rebase: Your resolution leaves this commit with no changes. The branch already has them. Skip it to go on with the rest.
empty.revert: Your resolution leaves nothing to revert. The branch is already like this. Skip it to go on.
empty.cherry_pick: Your resolution leaves this commit with no changes. The branch already has them. Skip it to go on.

skip.skipped: Skipped the commit with no changes.

abort.body: Your branch goes back to how it was before it started. Conflicts you've already resolved are lost.

done.aborted: Stopped. Your branch is back to how it was.

kind.both_added: Both sides added a file with this name.
kind.deleted_by_me: You deleted this file, but the other side changed it.
kind.deleted_by_them: You changed this file, but the other side deleted it.
kind.added_by_me: Only your side added this file.
kind.added_by_them: Only the other side added this file.

file.label: Resolve conflict
file.hint: Or edit the file to keep what you need, remove the conflict markers, and mark it as resolved.

markers.title: Conflict markers are still in this file
markers.body: {{name}} still has <<<<<<< and >>>>>>> lines. If you mark it resolved, they are committed as they are.
